title: Ghazali (Encyclopaedia Britannica, 1911)
summary: The life of al-Ghazali (1058 to 1111), professor at the Nizamiyya college in Baghdad who gave up his post, wandered for years, and wrote The Incoherence of the Philosophers and The Revival of the Religious Sciences. The article explains his attack on the philosophers and his defence of mystical experience, which Averroes later answered.
